summary.intent: Finish PR #1273 by wiring up staging environment configuration: refresh GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, generate and set IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY via 1Password without it touching disk, and add the MAIL_PROVIDER/SendGrid pair; also resolve whether an old docs branch was already merged.
summary.outcome: Confirmed the docs branch was merged (via PRs #1270/#1271) and flagged it stale/deletable. For PR #1273, set staging vars GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, MAIL_PROVIDER, MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS; generated a fresh RSA-2048 PKCS8 IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, stored it in 1Password, and set it as a GitHub secret entirely in-shell; patched deploy-staging.yml to write the three previously-missing mail env vars into .env.staging and added a guard that fails the job if required values are empty; corrected blueprint/deploy.md, which had told readers to retire SendGrid because 'v2 API has no email surface' — no longer true now that this PR restores it.

repo: deploy-staging.yml generates .env.staging from GitHub vars/secrets but previously omitted MAIL_PROVIDER, SENDGRID_API_KEY, and MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS even though the API refuses to boot under NODE_ENV=staging without MAIL_PROVIDER set.

gh's default `variable list`/`secret list` page size can silently hide entries (8 staging variables were missing from the first listing) — always check for pagination before concluding a var/secret doesn't exist.

blueprint/deploy.md had said to retire the SendGrid pair on the premise the v2 API has no email surface; that premise broke once PR #1273 restored email sending, so the doc needed a matching correction.
apps/api/src/auth/services/identity-token.service.ts expects IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY as a single-line base64-encoded PKCS8 PEM (RSA 2048).

code.finding: No health check followed `docker compose up -d`, so a deploy with an unset/empty required env var (e.g. mail config) would still report green while the API crash-loops; added an early guard step to fail fast on empty required values, plus added the three missing mail-related env vars to the .env.staging generation step.

workflow: When rotating a secret that must never touch disk, generate → store in 1Password → set as GitHub secret all within one shell pipeline/command, avoiding any intermediate file.
After changing a GitHub Actions workflow, run actionlint before committing/pushing to catch YAML/syntax issues early.

friction: Staging secrets (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, SENDGRID_API_KEY) were all stale, dating to the v1-era config (Feb 13/17), and the JWT key wasn't backed by any 1Password item.
gh CLI's default listing page size hid 8 existing staging variables on first pass, requiring a re-list to get the full picture.
deploy-staging.yml lacked a post-deploy health check, meaning a broken env config could pass CI as a successful deploy.
open_items: docs/blueprint-device-approval-rebased branch confirmed merged/stale but not yet deleted locally or on remote — awaiting user confirmation to delete.
Newly added guard step and updated deploy-staging.yml env generation haven't been validated against an actual staging deploy run.
Confirm nothing still reads the legacy SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL var now that MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS is the source of truth.
